title: Hands
description: One hand – one story to tell. Presented as three-dimensional pendants, made in different styles and colours.

title: Bearlings
description: Soft and gentle, a collection to make even a cold evening warmer. Presented as relief pendants, necklaces, and earrings with bears.

title: Sea Eagle
description: A narrative collection embodying the instinctive, feral, animal protection of one’s young. Deep blue tones, elegant pearl-white beads, and a bird placed at the center. Presented as big and heavy necklaces.

title: Seal
description: The absolute concentration of love and cuteness in one collection. Mostly presented as miniature paintings on pendants.

title: Special
description: The “Special” collection is inspired by the exotic form and colour of some animals. Mostly presented as miniature paintings on pendants.

title: Hanging forest
description: This is a collection for those who want to keep a part of the forest on and in them. Presented as three-dimensional multipart necklaces.

title: Camel's desert
description: The camel is a king and a slave of the desert. The collection presents miniature paintings on pendants with various motifs of camels, desert landscapes, and caravans.

title: Floral
description: Glowing colours, beads, and chains woven into deep black. Presented as pendants, necklaces, and earrings. Ornamental high-contrast designs inspired by the Baroque era.

title: Seagulls
description: Birds flying free as the wind. Mostly presented as miniature paintings on pendants.

title: Antelope
description: A collection for all antelopes and sometimes other horned friends. Presented as miniature paintings on pendants.

title: Three nuts
description: A kind and gentle fairytale. Presented as pendants and earrings in a brown-gold colour palette, often ornamental.

title: A walk in the woods
description: A folk tale unfolding in the deep forest thicket, shifting in mood — from shadowed, night-filled woodland to black-and-red sunset silhouettes of trees and silver-shimmering leaves touched by frost. Dedicated to all lovers of quiet walks. Presented as miniature paintings on pendants.

title: Red Hat
description: A poetic concept about people and their relationships with the world and each other. Presented as necklaces, made in an abstract style, simply coloured.

title: Nesting bird
description: A collection of birds giving a look straight into your soul. Presented as miniature paintings on pendants.

title: Characters
description: A poetic concept about people and their relationships with the world and each other. Presented as necklaces, made in an abstract style, simply coloured.

title: Baroque
description: Glowing colours, beads, and chains woven into deep black. Presented as pendants, necklaces, and earrings. Ornamental high-contrast designs inspired by the Baroque era.

title: Little bugs, little flowers
description: A collection with a light feeling of youth and spring. Mostly presented as necklaces with multiple parts and materials.

title: Micro world
description: Diverse, often ornamental motifs presented as small pendants and earrings, with the idea of building your own combinations.

title: Man and the ball
description: A metaphoric collection depicting a tense confrontation between man and the yellow ball. Presented as pendants and earrings, made in a minimalistic street style.

title: Gentle Lotus
description: Composed of a lotus seed pod and smooth decorative beads, sometimes with accents of wood. Inspired by the traditional Chinese water flower, a symbol of calm and inner harmony. Elegant and minimal in design. Presented as three-dimensional necklaces.
